card.name: Percent off and no cure
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "off" right after a percentage in price discounts, and "cure" after "no" in statements about diseases. Also fires weakly on scattered other words.

modes.label: Discount wording
modes.description: The word "off" right after a percent figure in prices or offers.

modes.label: No cure for disease
modes.description: The word "cure" after "no" when describing an illness.
modes.example: Multiple sclerosis is a progressive disease for which no<< cure>> has yet been found.

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Isolated words such as a place-type noun or a unit after a number.
